dataSourceNote: Curated baseline reference snapshot (Versa Malaysia fund sheets & US ETF index data); auto-updated on schedule via GitHub Actions calibration.

funds.name: Versa Cash
funds.underlying: AHAM Enhanced Deposit Fund (Malaysian bank deposits & short-term money market)
funds.laymanOneLiner: Your everyday Ringgit safety pot—earns Fixed-Deposit-like daily interest without locking up your money.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Protects emergency savings and short-term goals from stock market drops while beating normal bank savings accounts.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Returns move slowly when Bank Negara Malaysia changes interest rates; won't multiply wealth fast over 10+ years.
funds.malaysiaTip: Tax-exempt returns for Malaysian individuals and zero sales/withdrawal fees.

funds.name: Versa Cash-i
funds.underlying: AHAM Aiiman Enhanced i-Profit Fund (Islamic Wakalah/Murabahah deposits)
funds.laymanOneLiner: 100% Shariah-compliant Ringgit cash pot with steady daily profit and zero lock-in.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Ideal halal emergency buffer and safe parking spot while waiting to invest monthly.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Built for capital safety rather than beating long-term inflation aggressively.
funds.malaysiaTip: Fully Shariah-screened Islamic money market placements in MYR with RM10 minimum top-ups.

funds.name: Versa SGD
funds.underlying: AHAM SGD Money Market sleeve (Singapore Dollar deposits & short-term bills)
funds.laymanOneLiner: Lets you hold strong Singapore Dollars easily using Ringgit without opening a Singapore bank account.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Protects purchasing power if the Ringgit weakens against SGD while earning steady cash yield.
funds.laymanWatchOut: If the Ringgit strengthens sharply against SGD, your RM value can dip slightly in the short term.
funds.malaysiaTip: Popular among Malaysians saving for travel, regional expenses, or non-MYR safety.

funds.name: Versa Invest Moderate
funds.underlying: AHAM Global Multi-Asset Balanced (~50% global bonds/income, ~50% global equities)
funds.laymanOneLiner: A pre-mixed 'half cushion, half growth' global fund managed automatically in Ringgit.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Smoother ride than pure stock funds—good bridge between Versa Cash and global equities.
funds.laymanWatchOut: 1.05% annual fee is higher than DIY US ETFs, though convenient because there is zero FX hassle.
funds.malaysiaTip: Auto-rebalanced by AHAM in MYR—ideal for hands-off medium-term goals (2–5 years).

funds.name: Versa Invest Growth
funds.underlying: AHAM Global Growth Portfolio (Vanguard & BlackRock global equity ETFs sleeve)
funds.laymanOneLiner: All-in-one global stock portfolio in Ringgit—invests globally without needing a US broker.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Easiest RM100 automatic monthly global investing for beginners who prefer one Malaysian app.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Higher 1.20% annual management fee compared to buying VOO/VT directly (0.03%–0.06%).
funds.malaysiaTip: Great starter equity sleeve for small monthly RM amounts where US broker FX fees would feel costly.

funds.name: Versa Growth-i
funds.underlying: AHAM Aiiman Global Multi-Thematic / Shariah Equity Funds
funds.laymanOneLiner: Hands-off Shariah-compliant global growth portfolio funded directly in Ringgit.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Gives halal exposure to global healthcare, technology, and consumer leaders with RM100 minimum.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Can swing ~15–20% during global stock downturns; hold for at least 3–5+ years.
funds.malaysiaTip: Pairs naturally with Versa Cash-i for an effortless 100% halal Ringgit setup.

funds.name: Versa Global-i
funds.underlying: Shariah Global Developed Market Leaders sleeve
funds.laymanOneLiner: Invests in world-class Shariah-screened companies across the US, Europe, and Japan in RM.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Broad international Shariah stock exposure right inside Versa without currency conversion steps.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Higher ongoing fee than US-listed Shariah ETFs like SPUS/HLAL, so larger portfolios benefit from blending both.
funds.malaysiaTip: Regulated by Securities Commission Malaysia with local Shariah advisory oversight.

funds.name: Versa REITs
funds.underlying: AHAM Select Asia Pacific (ex-Japan) REITs Fund (Singapore, Australia, MY malls/logistics)
funds.laymanOneLiner: Be a mini-landlord across shopping malls, data centers, and warehouses in Singapore & Asia.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Collects steady rental-backed income without buying physical property or taking a bank mortgage.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Sensitive to interest rate hikes; meant as a small 5%–15% income diversifier, not your whole portfolio.
funds.malaysiaTip: Heavy exposure to quality Singapore REITs (CapitaLand, Mapletree) managed in Ringgit.

funds.name: Versa Gold
funds.underlying: LBMA Gold Price via physical gold bullion tracker
funds.laymanOneLiner: Shariah-compliant digital gold backed by real bullion—your crisis and inflation shield.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Often holds up or rises when stock markets panic, geopolitical tensions flare, or currencies weaken.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Gold pays zero dividends/interest; keep it as a 5%–10% portfolio spice rather than the main course.
funds.malaysiaTip: Much cheaper spread than buying physical gold bars or bank gold passbooks.

funds.name: Vanguard S&P 500 ETF
funds.category: US Large-Cap Core Index (Non-Individual Stock Basket)
funds.underlying: S&P 500 Index — 500 largest profitable US companies
funds.liquidity: Instant market hours · Fractional shares supported on MY-friendly brokers
funds.laymanOneLiner: One click buys tiny slices of America's 500 top companies—zero need to guess individual winning stocks.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Ultra-tiny 0.03% fee (RM 0.30 per RM 1,000/yr) and self-cleansing index: fading companies drop out, rising winners join automatically.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Can drop 20%–25% temporarily during recessions—stay invested and keep buying monthly.
funds.malaysiaTip: US dividends face 30% withholding tax (~0.38% drag on VOO's low yield). Advanced tip: Ireland-listed CSPX/VUAA cuts that tax in half.

funds.name: Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF
funds.underlying: CRSP US Total Market Index — Large, Mid & Small-Cap US stocks
funds.liquidity: Instant market hours · Fractional shares available
funds.laymanOneLiner: Owns virtually the entire US stock market (~3,600 companies)—both today's giants and tomorrow's mid-size stars.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Even broader diversification than the S&P 500 for the exact same rock-bottom 0.03% annual fee.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Moves closely with the US economy and USD/MYR exchange rate.
funds.malaysiaTip: Pick either VOO or VTI as your main US core—you don't need full weights in both since they overlap ~85%.

funds.name: Vanguard Total World Stock ETF
funds.underlying: FTSE Global All Cap Index (~63% US, ~37% Europe, Japan & Emerging Markets)
funds.liquidity: Instant market hours · Fractional shares available
funds.laymanOneLiner: The ultimate 'own the whole planet' fund—9,500+ companies worldwide in a single ticker.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Removes country guesswork completely: if Europe, Japan, or Asia outperforms America next decade, you already own them.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Slightly gentler historical return than US-only ETFs during US tech booms, in exchange for global safety.
funds.malaysiaTip: Replaces global unit trusts charging 1.5%–1.8% p.a. with a tiny 0.06% p.a. index fee.

funds.name: Invesco NASDAQ 100 ETF
funds.underlying: Nasdaq-100 Index — 100 largest non-financial Nasdaq companies
funds.liquidity: Instant market hours · Fractional shares available
funds.laymanOneLiner: Growth booster tracking 100 leading tech, AI, cloud, and consumer innovators (cheaper fee version of QQQ).
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Adds extra long-term growth horsepower alongside a steady core without gambling on one single tech stock.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Can drop 30%+ during tech selloffs—best kept at 10%–25% of your total portfolio for long timelines (7+ years).
funds.malaysiaTip: Always choose QQQM (0.15% fee) over QQQ (0.20% fee) for long-term buy-and-hold investing—exact same 100 companies!

funds.name: Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF
funds.underlying: Dow Jones U.S. Dividend 100 Index (profitable, low-debt, consistent dividend growers)
funds.liquidity: Instant market hours · Fractional shares available
funds.laymanOneLiner: 100 steady, profitable 'real economy' US companies (healthcare, consumer staples, industrials) with calmer swings.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Balances out tech-heavy indexes like VOO/QQQM because it focuses on cash flow and valuation discipline.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Malaysians lose 30% of cash dividends to US withholding tax (net yield ~2.4%), though total quality stability remains strong.
funds.malaysiaTip: Works best as a 10%–20% quality stabilizer sleeve rather than a pure dividend-living play due to US WHT.

funds.name: iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF
funds.underlying: US Treasury Bills maturing in 0 to 3 months
funds.laymanOneLiner: Ultra-safe US Dollar cash parking backed by the US Government—almost zero price fluctuation in USD.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Holds US Dollars safely while earning steady T-Bill yield, ready to deploy into US stock ETFs during market dips.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Value in RM still moves with the USD/MYR exchange rate.
funds.malaysiaTip: Treasury-interest distributions on SGOV generally qualify for US portfolio-interest WHT refunds on brokers like IBKR.

funds.name: SP Funds S&P 500 Sharia Industry Exclusions ETF
funds.underlying: S&P 500 Shariah Industry Exclusions Index (~200+ halal S&P 500 companies)
funds.liquidity: Instant market hours · Fractional shares available
funds.laymanOneLiner: The halal S&P 500—owns 200+ top US companies while automatically filtering out banks, alcohol, gambling, and high debt.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Gives Shariah investors direct access to America's strongest debt-light businesses at less than half the fee of local unit trusts.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Slightly higher tech/healthcare weight than regular S&P 500 because conventional financial banks are excluded.
funds.malaysiaTip: Low ~0.8% dividend yield means minimal US dividend tax impact; remember annual dividend purification (~2–5% of tiny dividends) per SP Funds reports.

funds.name: Wahed FTSE USA Shariah ETF
funds.category: Broad US Shariah Large & Mid-Cap Index
funds.underlying: FTSE USA Shariah Index (~230 US halal companies)
funds.liquidity: Instant market hours · Fractional shares available
funds.laymanOneLiner: Broadly diversified halal US stock index tracking ~230 large and mid-sized Shariah-compliant US companies.
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Complements SPUS with FTSE's Shariah screening methodology and additional mid-cap US business coverage.
funds.laymanWatchOut: 0.50% annual fee is higher than conventional ETFs, though still far cheaper than 1.5%–1.8% Islamic unit trusts.
funds.malaysiaTip: Very familiar benchmark for Malaysian halal investors; pairs smoothly with Versa Cash-i and Versa Gold.

funds.name: SP Funds Dow Jones Global Sukuk ETF
funds.underlying: Dow Jones Sukuk Total Return Index (sovereign & corporate A/BBB-rated USD Sukuk)
funds.laymanOneLiner: Halal US Dollar stabilizer investing in global investment-grade Islamic bonds (Sukuk).
funds.laymanWhyOwn: Cushions stock market drops in a Shariah portfolio while keeping part of your wealth anchored in USD.
funds.laymanWatchOut: Meant for steady USD income and stability rather than rapid capital appreciation.
funds.malaysiaTip: Great halal USD shock-absorber alongside SPUS/HLAL when you want lower volatility.
